case_identity_semantics: 240 unique case identities are paired/nested by seed; they are not 240 statistically independent samples

target_present.seed_audit: reserved_by_v3_2_confirmatory_design; re-audit all manifests and archives before freeze
target_present.pairing: same seed, speed, geometry, target state, clutter/noise realization; only channel-delay intervention changes

methods.provenance: R9 static calibration from R3 seed101 target-free A1_OFF C+N; docs/research/phase_r/R9_static_calibration_baseline.md

methods.allowed_input: same-case ON raw C1/C2 periods 0..k; same geometry and correction operator as M1
methods.algorithm_identity: audited batch candidate at source commit 1063d67c96af7dbbe7fe871b3a56be0ca453b9b2: physics_matched_delay._slope_baselines geometry-corrects observed_cross by geometry_cross, unwraps phase, magnitude-weights fit_weighted_line(robust=True); prefix runner not implemented
methods.robust_fit: 12 IRLS iterations; scale 1.4826*MAD with 1e-6 floor; standardized Huber cutoff 1.345
methods.shared_support_mask: same M1-selected mask: finite nonzero observed/geometry cross, nonzero frequency, and observed_cross magnitude >= 80th percentile of valid bins
methods.qualification_gate: finite D3 estimate; support_count >= 8; frequency_span_hz >= 3e6; D3 support_count equals M1 support_count
methods.known_gate_gap: current R21 qualifier does not enforce the M1 delay_bounds_samples on the D3 estimate; freeze Huber-specific delay-domain validity before V4
methods.failure_policy: explicit zero-correction C0 for the period; include in policy denominator

methods.role: full-case offline diagnostic; excluded from online ranking
known-error correction upper bound; evaluator-only truth

h0.seed_audit: initial text, path, and zip-filename scan found no collision; full registry audit required before freeze

methods.provenance: R9 static calibration from R3 seed101 target-free A1_OFF C+N

methods.allowed_input: same-case target-free C1/C2 periods 0..k; same geometry and correction operator as M1
methods.algorithm_identity: freeze exact implementation, weights, support rule, and source commit before execution
methods.failure_policy: explicit zero-correction C0 for the period; include in policy denominator

h0.primary_false_alarm_endpoint: seed-clustered proportion of valid beam-50 periods with >=1 frozen postfilter Detection
h0.scope_limit: beam-50, ten-period H0 endpoint; not full multi-beam system Pfa

allowed_inputs: same-case target-present ON raw C1/C2 pulses from periods 0 through current period k
pre-known sample rate and frequency axis
channel geometry and nominal electronic-scan delay configuration
forbidden_inputs: target truth, injected delay truth, target SNR truth, or evaluator associations
Known correction values or estimates from another seed
causal_estimator.application_timing: fit after period k input is complete and before Production processes period k
causal_estimator.causality_scope: period-boundary causal; not pulse-by-pulse real-time proof
causal_estimator.failure_policy: explicit zero-correction C0 for that period; log ESTIMATOR_UNAVAILABLE_ZERO_CORRECTION; count all opportunities; no previous-estimate, Fixed D3, batch, paired-reference, or Known fallback

existing_source_audit.audit_type: read-only source inspection; no estimator, Production, or CUDA execution
existing_source_audit.r22_input_scope: run_r22_cuda_pilot._raw_role_periods obtains all period_count paths; run_case passes the complete A1/ON path list to _blind_m1_from_b_on once
existing_source_audit.m1_estimator_scope: run_r12_physics_matched_delay._blind_m1_from_b_on concatenates C1/C2 samples from every passed period and estimates once; no period-k cutoff or period IDs
existing_source_audit.huber_candidate_scope: physics_matched_delay._slope_baselines computes a geometry-corrected magnitude-weighted robust phase-slope estimate from the same pooled input used by M1
existing_source_audit.huber_mask_coupling: Huber D3 reuses the M1-selected support mask: finite nonzero observed/geometry cross, nonzero frequencies, observed_cross magnitude at or above the 80th percentile of valid bins
existing_source_audit.huber_domain_gap: R21 qualifier checks finite D3 value, support >= 8, frequency span >= 3 MHz and support parity with M1, but has no explicit D3 delay-domain bound
existing_source_audit.production_correction_scope: run_r22_cuda_pilot._run_extra_delay_method accepts one case-level scalar estimate_ns and applies it to every period for ON/OFF/TO
required_before_freeze: ordered period_id mapping and explicit 0..k prefix input for both M1 and Huber
same prefix identity and geometry for the paired estimators
freeze whether the M1-shared frequency mask is intended for Huber and define Huber-specific delay-domain, validity, and fallback rules
per-period estimate and current-period-only correction application to paired ON/OFF/TO roles
explicit current-period zero-correction fallback in the policy denominator

primary_comparison.endpoint: paired seed-level equal-weight mean across three speed strata of position RMSE difference on frozen common correctly associated target-period opportunities
primary_comparison.contrast: M1_CAUSAL_PREFIX minus FIXED_D3; negative favors M1
primary_comparison.threshold_status: PENDING_ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENTS; do not freeze or run until approved

secondary_information_matched_comparison.endpoint: paired seed-level position RMSE on the same common correctly associated target-period opportunities
secondary_information_matched_comparison.contrast: M1_CAUSAL_PREFIX minus HUBER_D3_CAUSAL_PREFIX; negative favors M1
secondary_information_matched_comparison.status: PRESPECIFIED_SECONDARY; descriptive confidence interval only unless a separate engineering MDE is approved

planning_only_historical_screening.position_delta_definition: per-seed, per-speed pairwise-common-success RMSE difference; equal-weight mean across three speeds
planning_only_historical_screening.coverage_counts_crosscheck: matched opportunity counts agree with local V3.2 parameter_metrics_by_case.csv on 108 seed-speed-method rows
planning_only_historical_screening.interpretation_limit: descriptive screening precision only; not power, not evidence of a causal-prefix effect, and not a source for MDE/noninferiority thresholds

statistics.primary_interval: seed-cluster bootstrap 95% interval; resample seed with its full speed/target/period cluster
statistics.secondary_speed_tests: Holm correction across three speeds if inferential p-values are reported
statistics.power_status: not validated until engineering MDE and detection margin are specified

required_outputs: all-period Detection CSV and one-to-one target truth association for periods 0-9
candidates, clusters, cluster/detection lineage, CFAR geometry, valid CUT denominator and unique-hit summary
actual TrackManager per-frame state, associated detection and PIPE payload audit with field sources
truth-aligned target-only complex response at common frozen ROI and named processing taps
per-period causal estimator prefix inputs, estimate, correction, runtime, status and explicit fallback
per-period Huber D3 causal-prefix inputs, estimate, correction, runtime, status and explicit fallback
runtime XML, Stage2 reports, input hashes, background reuse mapping, source/binary identities, device snapshot, commands, logs and exit codes
compact case archive, member inventory, CRC/SHA verification, evaluability state and cleanup ledger

storage_policy.required_resource_gate: user-authorized representative complete-output pilot before the confirmatory matrix
storage_policy.post_review_target: remove dispensable intermediates; retain necessary records/config/audit/high-value evidence and keep final project below 20 GiB

freeze_blockers: implement and audit the per-period M1/Huber prefix runner; current source is full-case batch with one case-level correction scalar
freeze Huber shared-mask policy and Huber-specific delay-domain validity/fallback; current qualifier has no D3 delay-bound check
optional track-protection limits if used for a success claim
implement and verify the per-period estimator/output schema, including future-period isolation
final seed collision and pairing audit
user authorization for representative CUDA/output-size pilot
resource and resume/cleanup gate derived from measured pilot
stop_conditions: invalid area-clutter injection or paired background identity
Native CUDA production, valid-CUT, scan-beam, or TrackManager lineage failure
future-period or oracle information reaches M1 causal estimator
Huber and M1 prefix input identities or period bounds differ
estimator failure hidden or excluded from the full policy denominator
missing all-period Detection, target response, or independent H0 lineage
archive identity/CRC failure or unsafe resume identity change
resource state cannot complete one atomic case safely
